content.short: Attarius Network helps Web2 developers, players, and NFT creators transition to Web3.
content.description: Web2 developers often lack the expertise to integrate Web3 features, and many Web3 projects suffer from unfriendly UX that can hinder adoption. Attarius Network delivers a three-component ecosystem that acts as a bridge between Web2 and Web3. Its Multichain API is a zero-code solution that enables Web2 developers to add Web3 capabilities to their apps—NFTs, user login, deploying smart contracts, and non-custodial wallets for users.
content.meta: Attarius Network provides NFT tooling and a zero-code API to bring Web3 to Web2. Discover Attarius Network and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
